title: Package Boards inside humblebundle exports
summary: A Board would become machine-local state instead of a durable project artifact, undermining git audit and cross-repository use. Extend the bundle manifest with optional versioned boards and assets while preserving compatibility with existing bundles and read-only imports.
acceptance_criteria: The humblebundle manifest supports optional versioned Board documents and Board-owned assets without making them mandatory for existing bundles.
Existing design-only bundles continue to load unchanged in native and web fallback surfaces.
Board assets use relative paths with traversal protection, duplicate detection and checksum or equivalent integrity metadata.
Import exposes explicit supported, unsupported-version, corrupt and missing-asset states.
Export is deterministic for unchanged Board state and never includes local absolute paths, bookmarks or credentials.
A sample bundle includes one Board fixture and passes native import plus repository validation.
The contract is documented for producer repositories such as MyVltavaRun.

evidence.note: The product supports URL, file, supported-app and demo import paths.
design.json and humblebundle are the portable source contracts.
App repositories own their exported Humble artifacts.
Authoring trails are intended to remain auditable in git.

blocked_by.reason: Required Board foundation must be solved first.

trigger.source_ref: HumbleStudio Board architecture finding HS-BAR-009, requested by Jan.
